discuss.description: Discuss defaults. Used when a blocked gate node does not declare its own discuss.agent.

defaultAgent.description: Default agent for gate discuss sessions. Used when the blocked gate node does not declare its own discuss.agent.

globalConcurrency.description: Shared ceiling for every flow-run concurrency mechanism — agent dispatch, subflow fan-out, and whole-flow-run concurrency alike (engine/global-concurrency.js). Default: 8.

profilePath.description: Absolute path of the PROFILE.md file guarded by the before_tool_call read gate and edit lock (hooks/profile-read-gate.js, hooks/profile-write-lock.js). Default: ~/.openclaw/workspace/.shared/freelance/profile/PROFILE.md

profileEditResultsDir.description: Directory the edit lock writes one <runId>.json outcome marker per guarded PROFILE.md edit into (hooks/profile-write-lock.js). Default: ~/.openclaw/locks/profile-edit-results
